scripts.build:server: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build:server -w apps/web
scripts.test:browser:server: npm run build:server && node --import tsx tests/server-browser.integration.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/worker && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts apps/worker/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:worker: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/worker && node --import tsx --test apps/worker/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:native" "npm run dev:native -w apps/web"
scripts.test:browser: npm run prepare:wasm && node --import tsx tests/browser.integration.mjs
scripts.test:browser:native: npm run prepare:wasm && node --import tsx tests/browser.integration.mjs --native
scripts.test:browser:duration: npm run prepare:wasm && node --import tsx tests/browser-duration.integration.mjs
